title: RL Post-training (async)
description: Concurrent rollout and Megatron training diagnostics. Select one run and job, then the execution processes to inspect. Missing telemetry is unknown, not zero.

params.value: SELECT run_id AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND name IN ('lifecycle','policy_step','rollout_call') AND json_get(resource_attributes_json,'training_loop')='async') GROUP BY run_id HAVING run_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY MAX(timestamp_ms) DESC

SELECT job_id AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring})) GROUP BY job_id HAVING job_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY MAX(timestamp_ms) DESC

SELECT execution_uid AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring})) GROUP BY execution_uid HAVING execution_uid IS NOT NULL ORDER BY MAX(timestamp_ms) DESC

panels.title: Optimizer and synced policy steps
panels.description: Per-bucket maximum of policy_step (the trainer's current optimizer step) and the model version carried on weight_sync_completed, one series per execution. policy_step is set on every step; weight_sync_completed fires after each weight sync to the vLLM engines. The weight-sync series needs trainer.training_metrics; policy_step is always on.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Generated and consumed response tokens / s
panels.description: Per-second rate of work_completed token counts for generated_token, consumed_response_token and consumed_loss_token, summed per bucket. Generation workers record generated tokens when a group finishes; the trainer records consumed tokens after each optimizer step. The generated-token series is always on; the two consumed-token series need trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Process lifecycle
panels.description: Latest lifecycle or terminal event per process: its status, exit reason and last-record time. Every trainer, generation-worker and controller process emits lifecycle on start and terminal on exit. Always on when telemetry is configured; a completed process does not by itself mean training succeeded.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Driver step, preparation and policy walls
panels.description: Mean phase_duration_seconds for the driver's step, wait_for_generation_buffer, run_training, fwd_logprobs_values_reward and train_critic_and_policy phases, per bucket. Each is a Timer span the trainer publishes after every step. Always on when telemetry is configured; step, run_training and train_critic_and_policy are nested, so never add them.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Generation worker await duration
panels.description: Mean and max rollout_wait_seconds by wait name (prompt, slot, enqueue, model_client_await, env_await), the mean normalized by rollout_waits. Generation workers record these inside TrajectoryRunner.run(), including the wait on AsyncStalenessManager.acquire_submission_slot(). Empty without trainer.async_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Completed buffer depth and capacity
panels.description: Latest rollout_queue_depth and rollout_capacity gauges per bucket: the GenerationOutputGroupBuffer's occupancy against trainer.fully_async.max_buffered_groups. The trainer updates both whenever a group enters or leaves the buffer. Always on when telemetry is configured; sampled zeros can miss short occupancy bursts.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Consumed buffer dwell
panels.description: p50/p95/max of rollout_buffer_dwell_seconds for groups with disposition=consumed: time from group completion to trainer admission. Recorded when a consumed group leaves the GenerationOutputGroupBuffer. Empty without trainer.async_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Consumed policy staleness
panels.description: p50/p95/max of rollout_staleness_steps: how many optimizer steps behind the model was when each admitted group was consumed. The trainer records one observation per group against max_staleness_steps. Always on when telemetry is configured; rejected groups are excluded.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Successful rollout-call latency
panels.description: p50/p95/max of phase_duration_seconds for phase=rollout_call: the wall time of one successful TrajectoryRunner.run() call. Recorded by observe_rollout_call around each generation-worker rollout. Empty without trainer.async_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Weight synchronization and policy offload walls
panels.description: Mean phase_duration_seconds for sync_weights, init_weight_sync_state, offload_policy_model_to_cpu and update_ref_with_policy, split by outcome and execution. sync_weights times broadcast_to_inference_engines; the rest time the one-time sync-state setup and the optimizer offload around it. Always on when telemetry is configured; these are elapsed waits, not GPU kernel time.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Driver event-loop lag
panels.description: Max event_loop_lag_seconds per bucket: how late the driver's asyncio loop ran past its scheduled tick. Sampled once a second by monitor_event_loop_lag on the trainer's event loop. Empty without trainer.async_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Signed timing residuals
panels.description: Min signed phase_duration_seconds for rollout_call_residual and ppo_train_residual, by rank and execution: wall time inside a span not attributed to any named child phase. Negative values expose overlapping child accounting and are not clamped. Empty without trainer.async_spans (rollout residual) or trainer.policy_train_spans (Megatron residual).

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Concurrent work and terminal group dispositions
Rollouts completing during policy training
panels.description: Successful rollout_call events whose finish falls inside an async_phase_window phase=training interval, grouped by optimizer step. Both are driver-recorded with explicit start/finish timestamps and joined on overlap. Empty without trainer.async_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Group dispositions / bucket
panels.description: Per-bucket sum of rollout_groups: the count of groups reaching each terminal disposition (consumed, rejected, stale_enqueue, shutdown-pending). Recorded once per group when record_group_disposition closes it out. Empty without trainer.async_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Tokens by group disposition / bucket
panels.description: Per-bucket sum of rollout_group_tokens: response tokens attached to each terminal group disposition. Recorded alongside rollout_groups by record_group_disposition. Empty without trainer.async_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Training reward and informative groups
panels.description: training_metric_value for reward/avg_raw_reward, reward/avg_pass_at_4 and reward/informative_group_fraction, one point per optimizer step. Logged by the trainer from the reward-shaping and group-admission pass over each mini-batch. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Evaluation scores
panels.description: training_metric_value for every eval/% metric: held-out scores mirrored from the evaluation tracker. Written only at evaluation steps, one point per metric and execution. Empty without trainer.training_metrics; blank between evaluation steps means no evaluation ran, not zero accuracy.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Consumed length stops and coverage
panels.description: training_metric_value for consumed/length_stop_fraction and consumed/stop_reason_coverage: the share of admitted response sequences that hit a length stop, gated on full stop-reason coverage. Logged by the trainer after the learner update consumes the batch. Empty without trainer.training_metrics; the fraction is null wherever coverage is incomplete.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Optimizer diagnostics
panels.description: training_metric_value for policy/policy_entropy, policy/raw_grad_norm, policy/policy_kl, policy/final_loss and policy/policy_loss, one point per optimizer step. Logged by the policy worker after each optimizer_step call. Empty without trainer.training_metrics; these are different quantities and are not additive.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Megatron policy wall by rank
panels.description: phase_duration_seconds for phase=ppo_train, one point per rank and outcome: the Megatron policy worker's wall time for one optimizer update. Recorded by LearnerMemory around PolicyWorkerBase.ppo_train. Empty without trainer.policy_train_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Megatron phase detail
panels.description: phase_duration_seconds for every Megatron-backend phase, by step, rank, phase and outcome, newest steps first. Recorded by LearnerMemory inside PolicyWorkerBase.ppo_train. Empty without trainer.policy_train_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Exporter and nonfinite observations
panels.description: Per process: summed training_nonfinite_values, and the max cumulative telemetry_lost_records / telemetry_rejected_records exporter gauges. The nonfinite counter comes from record_training_metrics; the exporter gauges are native to the telemetry pipeline. The nonfinite series needs trainer.training_metrics; the exporter gauges are always on.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Pre-update model log-ratio drift
panels.description: training_metric_value for policy/mismatch/pooled/log_ratio_*: the learner's pre-update logprob minus the vLLM engine's recorded logprob, over finite loss tokens. Computed by mismatch_ratio_metrics in fwd_logprobs_values_reward, before the optimizer step consumes the batch. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Pre-update PPO-window pressure
panels.description: training_metric_value for policy/mismatch/pooled/lower_clip_pressure and upper_clip_pressure: the fraction of finite loss tokens outside the configured PPO ratio bounds. Computed by mismatch_ratio_metrics alongside the log-ratio drift metrics. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Drift coverage and token-weight concentration
panels.description: training_metric_value for policy/mismatch/pooled/finite_fraction, missing_behavior and ess_fraction: coverage and importance-weight concentration of the learner/vLLM mismatch. Computed by mismatch_ratio_metrics from the same batch as the drift panels. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Mean squared model log-ratio
panels.description: training_metric_value for policy/mismatch/pooled/log_ratio_mean_squared: the mean squared learner-minus-vLLM logprob difference over finite loss tokens. Computed by mismatch_ratio_metrics before the optimizer update. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: TIS correction skips
panels.description: training_metric_value for tis/batch_skipped_no_logprobs and tis/skipped_fraction: whether a batch's TIS correction fell back to the standard policy loss because rollout_logprobs were missing. Logged by the trainer when trainer.algorithm.use_tis is on. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Core and cycle duration
panels.description: training_metric_value for async/performance/core_seconds, cycle_seconds and outside_core_seconds: the fully-async step's core wall and the surrounding cycle, including checkpoint/eval callbacks. Computed by async_step_metrics after each optimizer step. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Consumed loss tokens per second
panels.description: training_metric_value for async/performance/consumed_loss_tokens_per_core_second and per_cycle_second: useful loss tokens divided by core or cycle wall. Computed by async_step_metrics alongside the core/cycle durations. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Core wall fractions
panels.description: training_metric_value for async/performance/buffer_wait_fraction, training_fraction and weight_sync_fraction: the driver's core wall split across waiting for a full admitted batch, run_training and sync_weights. Computed by async_step_metrics from the same step timings as Core and cycle duration. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Useful tokens per configured role GPU-second
panels.description: training_metric_value for async/performance/loss_tokens_per_configured_policy_gpu_second and response_tokens_per_configured_inference_gpu_second. Computed by async_step_metrics from consumed work divided by the configured policy and inference GPU counts, not measured vLLM engine utilization. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Configured role GPU counts
panels.description: training_metric_value for async/performance/configured_policy_gpus and configured_inference_gpus: policy nodes x GPUs/node, and inference engines x TP x PP x DP. Computed by async_step_metrics from trainer.placement and the generator config. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Learner memory by phase
panels.description: cuda_memory_observation for the policy worker: peak/reserved/allocated bytes and free device memory, by rank, GPU and phase. Recorded by LearnerMemory around each policy phase. Empty without trainer.policy_train_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching observations

panels.title: Inference sampled throughput by learner phase
panels.description: vLLM generation_tokens_total / prompt_tokens_total counter deltas, rated per covered second and joined to async_phase_window driver phases. The vLLM engines export the counters independently; the trainer emits the phase windows to join against. Empty without trainer.async_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching observations

panels.title: Cumulative core GPU-hours in selected window
panels.description: Running sum of async/performance/core_seconds times configured policy+inference GPUs, divided by 3600, accumulated over complete rows in the window. Computed by async_step_metrics per optimizer step, cumulative within each execution. Empty without trainer.training_metrics; excludes startup, eval, checkpoint and export time.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.description: Per-execution rollups of training_metric_value for optimizer batches whose async/staleness_min equals async/staleness_max: response length, token-weighted mean squared log-ratio, minimum ESS fraction and mean raw reward, one row per staleness value. Built from the same per-step metrics as the drift panels, restricted to uniform-staleness batches. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching diagnostics.

panels.title: Uniform-staleness batch diagnostics

panels.description: Fraction of consumed loss tokens (async/performance/consumed_loss_tokens) that fall in a batch eligible for the uniform-staleness table above. Computed from the same training_metric_value rows, over the selected runs, jobs, executions and window. Empty without trainer.training_metrics; null means no observed tokens, not zero or full coverage.

defaults.noValue: No valid token denominator

panels.title: Uniform-staleness diagnostic token coverage
Evaluation response length and stop coverage
panels.description: training_metric_value for eval/%/response_tokens_mean, response_tokens_max, length_stop_fraction, completed_stop_fraction and stop_reason_coverage. Logged by the trainer at each evaluation step from the finalized trajectories' stop reasons. Empty without trainer.training_metrics; fractions are blank wherever stop-reason coverage is incomplete.

defaults.noValue: No supplemental evaluation observations

panels.title: Evaluation score contributions by stop class
panels.description: training_metric_value for eval/%/avg_score, length_stop_score_contribution and completed_stop_score_contribution. Logged alongside the response-length panel at each evaluation step. Empty without trainer.training_metrics; the two contributions need not sum to avg_score.

defaults.noValue: No supplemental evaluation observations

panels.title: Consumed staleness — groups per step
panels.description: Count of rollout_staleness_steps observations per optimizer step, split by staleness value: how many admitted groups landed at each staleness. The trainer records one observation per group in record_rollout_staleness. Always on when telemetry is configured; rejected groups are excluded.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Consumed staleness — tokens per step
panels.description: Sum of response_tokens on consumed_staleness events per optimizer step, split by staleness value. The trainer emits one event per consumed group, carrying its admitted staleness and token count. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Weight-sync stages
panels.description: async_phase_window intervals for phase=training and weight_sync, plus a 1 ms marker at each weight_sync_completed event, per execution. The trainer opens and closes the phase windows around each step and the loop's weight sync. Empty without trainer.async_spans for the intervals, or trainer.training_metrics for the completion marks.

panels.title: Learner/vLLM mismatch ρ (staleness 0)
panels.description: training_metric_value for policy/mismatch/staleness0/*: log-ratio mean/p99/p999, the fraction outside [0.5x, 2x], ESS fraction, KL and chi-squared, for staleness-zero loss tokens only. Computed by mismatch_ratio_metrics, isolating tokens with no policy drift since generation. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Learner/vLLM mismatch by staleness bucket
panels.description: training_metric_value for policy/mismatch/staleness{0,1,2,3,4-7,8+}/log_ratio_abs_mean: mean absolute learner/vLLM log-ratio by the group's staleness at consumption. Computed by mismatch_ratio_metrics from the same batch as the staleness-0 panel. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Learner drift within the update
panels.description: training_metric_value for policy/log_ratio_*: the learner's ratio against its own logprobs recomputed at consumption, pooled over the update's microbatches. Computed by LogRatioMonitor in the policy worker's training step, independent of the rollout-time mismatch panels. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Position dependence of |log ρ|
panels.description: training_metric_value for policy/mismatch/pooled/pos_* and policy/log_ratio_pos_*: mean absolute log-ratio by response position (first/last 256 tokens, middle) for the rollout-mismatch and within-update-drift families. Computed by mismatch_ratio_metrics and LogRatioMonitor using trainer.algorithm.ratio_diagnostics.position_window. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Gradient direction persistence
panels.description: training_metric_value for policy/grad_cosine, grad_cosine_min/max and grad_norm_reduced/raw_grad_norm: cosine similarity between successive gradients and their norms. Logged by the policy worker's gradient-direction tracker after each optimizer step. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Correction activity
panels.description: training_metric_value for policy/offpolicy_mask/*, policy/m2_mask/*, policy/ppo_clip_ratio and policy/tis/imp_ratio_capped_fraction: token-masking and clipping activity from the off-policy, M2 and TIS corrections. Logged by the policy worker after each optimizer step. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.
